newsitem.title: UK: Discount gas prices may be forced up - paper.
newsitem.headline: Discount gas prices may be forced up - paper.

text.p: Independent gas companies offering up to 25 percent discount on customers' bills may have to raise prices if the government's competition watchdog decides not to back proposals to cut pipeline fees, said the Financial Times.
The fees, levied by British Gas are currently under review by industry regulator Clare Spottiswoode. The Monopolies and Mergers Commission is expected to issue a report in April.

The newspaper said some industry executives believe the more aggressive price discounts may be unsustainable if the regulator does not back the proposals. Gas transport fees account for about one third of the final price of gas, the paper said.
